description: Enrich flow performance with processing efficiency, queue utilization, and throughput calculations

script.source: if (ctx.queuedCount != null && ctx.backPressureObjectThreshold != null && ctx.backPressureObjectThreshold > 0) { ctx.queueUtilizationPercent = (float)(ctx.queuedCount * 100.0 / ctx.backPressureObjectThreshold); }
if (ctx.bytesTransferred != null && ctx.processingNanos != null && ctx.processingNanos > 0) { ctx.throughputBytesPerSecond = (float)(ctx.bytesTransferred * 1000000000.0 / ctx.processingNanos); }

if (ctx.invocations != null && ctx.processingNanos != null && ctx.invocations > 0 && ctx.processingNanos > 0) { ctx.processingEfficiency = (float)(ctx.bytesTransferred / (ctx.processingNanos / 1000000.0)); }
